_meta.scope: The four features shipped in this session, measured on a snapshot of the production store (5216 non-reference memories, 1099 documents, 616 session archives).
_meta.method: Cold numbers are a fresh CLI process (/usr/bin/time -p, the way a hook or a user invokes it). Warm numbers are in-process, median of 3-5 runs.
_meta.caveat: Read the cold numbers. The warm ones reuse one MemoryStore and hide the ~0.9s process start every real invocation pays — the same artifact that made an earlier 6.2ms p50 misleading.

consolidation_value_guard.what: consolidate() refuses to merge members that disagree about a concrete value.

cost_isolated.reading: The guard only runs on pairs already above threshold, so its worst case costs about the same as the single 5216x5216 matmul it rides on — roughly 3% of a ~1.1s consolidate() call. Free in practice.

cost_end_to_end_warm_ms.reading: Differences are inside run-to-run noise on a ~1.1s operation; two of three read negative because a blocked pair skips the merge bookkeeping. Use the isolated numbers, not these.

effect.note: The guard is no longer inert at the shipping default. Earlier today 0.92 had zero pairs either way; the store has since grown and one pair now clears 0.92 with diverging values. Without the guard that pair would have merged and dropped a fact.

doc_list_depth_summary.what: `memory doc list --depth summary` omits each document's body.
doc_list_depth_summary.reading: The saving is not just transfer size — serialising 4 MB of bodies was about half the wall time.

markdown_export_mirror.what: `memory admin export --markdown DIR`, one file per record.
markdown_export_mirror.note: collisions was 1 before the duplicate documents row was removed earlier today; it is the counter that surfaced that row in the first place.

handoff_prune_archives.reading: A dry run over the whole archive set is one pass and ~3s. Deletion is the expensive half at 0.82s per document, all of it cold CLI start — which is why the auto-prune caps at 50 per run (~41s worst case, spread over days) rather than doing 208 in one handoff (~2.8 min).

retrieval_regression_check.method: AST-level comparison of every function body in core.py between 1a31d85 (pre-session) and HEAD, rather than a noisy end-to-end replay.
retrieval_regression_check.reading: search, _search_hybrid/_semantic/_fts/_exact/_graph, _weighted_fuse, _rrf_fuse, compute_activation, _get_hubness, _promote_exact_matches, _build_time_filter and the doc-search paths are byte-identical to the pre-session revision. Retrieval quality cannot have moved.
